title: Canon EOS 5D Mark III 22.3MP Full-Frame Classic DSLR (Best Value Classic Full-Frame DSLR)
purpose: The legendary full-frame DSLR workhorse ('Best Cheap / Value Full-Frame DSLR'): 22.3MP Full-Frame CMOS sensor with gapless microlenses, DIGIC 5+ processor, 61-point High-Density Reticular AF, 6 fps continuous shooting, and timeless, organic Canon full-frame color rendering revered by wedding, portrait, and documentary photographers worldwide.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 36.0 x 24.0mm Full-Frame CMOS sensor with gapless microlenses (22.3MP, 5760 x 3840)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon EF 50mm f/1.2L USM (Classic Editorial & Documentary Fast Standard Prime)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensitivity (ISO 100–25,600, expandable to L:50 and H2:102,400)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: Large 6.25 µm full-frame pixel pitch delivering organic, film-like highlight roll-off and rich color depth
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/8000s to 30s magnesium-alloy weather-sealed shutter rated to 150,000 cycles, 6 fps burst, 1/200s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Available natural window light, golden hour sun flare, or warm tungsten reception ambient light
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Organic, forgiving highlight roll-off characteristic of large 6.25 µm full-frame pixels paired with fast EF L-series primes, producing warm skin tones and gentle shadow transitions

surface_rendering: 22.3MP full-frame sensor with large 6.25 µm photoreceptors rendering smooth, organic skin texture with natural pores and zero clinical digital harshness
Classic Canon DIGIC 5+ color science prized for rich reds, warm golden skin hues, and film-like tonal transitions
Authentic optical character of Canon EF L-series glass with subtle spherical glow wide open and tack-sharp focal plane stopped down
depth_and_optics: 61-point High-Density Reticular AF (41 cross-type points, 5 dual-diagonal cross-type at f/2.8) locked on the subject's eyes
Dreamy full-frame shallow depth of field with Canon EF 50mm f/1.2L USM or EF 85mm f/1.2L II USM painterly background melt
True 35mm full-frame perspective with natural optical vignetting and organic highlight bokeh discs

execution_directive: Enforce Canon EOS 5D Mark III 22.3MP Full-Frame DSLR optical character with large 6.25 µm pixel tonal smoothness, fast Canon EF L-series primes, and timeless warm editorial skin rendering.
